Start your journey
Materials Science and Engineering at CU Boulder offers multiple academic program options to develop your future. As a student, you will work at the intersection of science and engineering in advanced chemistry, biology, engineering and physics.
Here you will be taught by some of the country's best faculty who are making a difference through innovation and collaboration.
Degree Options
Doctor of Philosophy
Master of Science
Bachelor’s-Accelerated Master’s
Undergraduate Minor
The enrollment process varies depending on your program choice.
Prospective PhD and Master's students should explore the links to the right to find out more about the application steps.
Bachelor's-Accelerated-Master's students should visit our BAM program page for full details. CU Boulder undergraduate students interested in the the Materials Science & Engineering minor should visit the program minor page and complete the minor intent form.
